name: hue-suite
description: Philips Hue desktop app, MCP server and agent tools

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/hue-core packages/hue-mcp packages/hue-mock-bridge && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/hue-mcp && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build -w packages/hue-mcp && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
